Let's brake it down for those who really wants to buy this game in 2026 or later in the future (Even after ARMA 4 release). This game is truly not for everyone - It takes several hours if not hundreds just to get into 
all of the controls and understanding of how game works. And also - If you plan to buy it without any DLC - 
It's not entirely problematic, you have a thousands of mods released by the community on the workshop 
almost everyday, but for some you definitely have to buy even the simplest but Official (from Helicopters and Jets to Apex) and Creators DLCs developed by the fans for the fans and published under approval of Bohemia Interactive. 

To Simplify  - Before you buy, you have to know what you're signing up for and which each type of purchased experience (Pure Vanilla, Some DLC or all Major if not all of them)

Vanilla Only - If you bought this game (and most realistically on sales) without any DLCs than you are either trying it to see if you can get into it and will you like it or not or you just want to play the completely modded experience for only 4 dollars
It has only the basics - East Wind Campaign, Tutorials and showcases (Including Art of War and Zeus which were added for free to this game) and a workshop with hundreds of thousands of mods published daily or almost daily.

You Bought the Ultimate Version (With or Without APEX) - If you bought an Ultimate version with basic yet most important DLCs (Even including APEX) you've just opened for yourself larger possibilities for Multiplayer - New verity of modes and ability to join them, New "Old Man" Campaign and with them your mod collection feels way more complete (I recommend this type of purchase for bigger choice and decision making in building your own scenarios or unlock more possibilities in Multiplayer)
If you bought this configuration you really know what you are doing and what you are going for.

Creators DLC:
Most Important Ones:
MAC V S.O.G. Campaign - Basically all of Mods and Vietnam content in one DLC.
If you think RS2V or HLL Vietnam is too simple for you and you wish for more "Tactical" & "Realistic" approach - Buy this DLC and ask no more
Western Sahara - Great DLC for those who into Middle Easter esthetics but also want to buy a Creator DLC for cheaper + Quite a number of mods require this DLC (Just Like S.O.G. Required by all of Vietnam mods and scenarios earlier). So this one also worth buying for your better ARMA experience 

Reaction and Expeditionary Mods - For those who rather prefer Search and Rescue instead of All out warfare + required by majority of DLC based mods.

Others are on your preference and ratings of the community.

Special P.s:
You bought base game with monthly subscription or you want to try to:
Son..... You better not....
